summary.text: Stephanie Walsh is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Mylie Biggs with no incumbent in the race.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a businesswoman and engineer with more than 30 years of experience in energy, engineering and business.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Walsh earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Idaho in 1989, and her career experience includes working as a mechanical engineer.
Walsh advanced from the Democratic primary for District 14 on July 21, 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she named housing affordability, strengthening career and technical education and stabilizing public education funding, investment in water, energy, grid and transportation infrastructure, a family-friendly and small business-friendly tax environment, and an improved state budgeting process among her policy priorities.
